statement: Agent A drops this fund from its held-out cohort (agentA_cohort_excluded, 14 fund-quarter findings) because the identifier grammar parses 219 of 244 matching identifiers (89.8 pct, bar 90.0) at 2026-06-30. The cause is a mixed date order inside one filing, not one convention. Of the 323 dated identifiers of the 2026-06-30 filing (0001193125-26-346851), 240 read correctly only month-first, 12 either way, and 68 only day-first ('Maturity Date 17/6/2030' for printed 6/17/2030): 39 are unambiguous (first number above 12) and 29 are ambiguous (both numbers 12 or less: AB Centers '2/7/2031' prints 7/2/2031, '1/11/2029' prints 11/1/2029). 78 other rows with both numbers 12 or less are month-first (Aeron Buyer 'Maturity Date 1/2/2032' is January 2, 2032). So neither a month-first rule nor a filing-wide day-first setting is right: a day-first default would misread the 78 month-first ambiguous rows, and month-first misreads the 29. The identifier text carries no marker of the order; the published maturity (from the structured fact) and the printed page are right in all 323. Quarters 2025-06-30 to 2026-03-31 have no day-first identifier (0 of 1,138), so the issue starts with the 2026-06-30 filing. Repair, in two parts. (1) Shared, unambiguous: date_mdy coercion reads a date whose first number is above 12 and second 12 or less as day/month/year (the 39 unambiguous rows; no month exceeds 12); this alone brings completeness to 100 pct, because the 29 ambiguous rows already parse (month-first, wrongly). (2) The 29 ambiguous rows must not be left to a heuristic: add an opt-in, exact-context declaration of the filer's identifier convention (wrapper source_encodings, same pattern as position_identity_contexts: 'ACCESSION CONTEXT => dmy'), listing the contexts whose identifier text is day-first, read from the printed page; the grammar reads those contexts day-first and every other context as before. The 68 day-first contexts (29 ambiguous, 39 unambiguous) of the 2026-06-30 filing are in scratch/fund_runs/0001920453/dmy_contexts.txt. Tests: (a) unambiguous: '17/6/2030' under a declared context and under no declaration both give 2030-06-17; (b) ambiguous: '2/7/2031' with the context declared day-first gives 2031-07-02, the same string on an undeclared context gives 2031-02-07, and 'Maturity Date 1/2/2032' on the undeclared Aeron Buyer context stays 2032-01-02; (c) an impossible date (31/31/2030) returns None; (d) a fund without a declaration is read exactly as before. Without part (2) the fund re-enters the cohort with 29 false maturity flags. Production consequence: batch b1112b read the stale 2024-07-24 agent_a_flags.csv (374 flags for this fund); the next batch carries them as agentA_cohort_excluded, so the 18 agentA findings of this fund return unread (listed under not_done in the report).
